candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes 'nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots' and CSF analysis showing 'atypical cells/blasts', which supports leptomeningeal disease of the lumbosacral nerve roots. However, this is a manifestation/component of the underlying Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) and not the full diagnosis itself.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: describes a component of the overall diagnosis, but not the primary neoplasm or its specific type
